# Town of Middletown Springs municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 14; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Middletown Springs (official website), Selectboard page: seats Robin Chesnut-Tangerman (Chair), Isaac Yackel (Vice Chair), Terry Redfield, and Chris Fenton, and notes Neil Russell was APPOINTED to the board on September 10, 2026

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Middletown Springs' selectboard as Robin Chesnut-Tangerman, Isaac Yackel, Chris Fenton, Carl Haynes, and Terry Redfield; the directory predates Haynes's departure and Russell's appointment, which the town's own page records

Town of Middletown Springs (official website), Town Clerk's Office page: names Patty Kenyon Town Clerk (three-year term ending March 2027) and describes the clerk as 'an independent official, answerable only to the voters'
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Patty Kenyon as Middletown Springs' town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Patty Kenyon as Middletown Springs' town clerk
Town of Middletown Springs (official website), Treasurer / Delinquent Tax Collector page: names Jenny Talke Munyak Town Treasurer (elected, three-year term); the full name form is the town page's
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Jenny Talke Munyak as Middletown Springs' town treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists 'Jenny Munyak' as Middletown Springs' town treasurer -- the same person, shortened form

sources.note: Town of Middletown Springs, FY2024 Town Report: the FY2024 report's elected-officers table carries Heather Grier as Collector of Delinquent Taxes with the footnote '* Appointed Until Town Meeting 2025': the office is elective (three-year term) but her last verified mode is the appointment and no published 2025 outcome was reachable, so she is minted appointed and flagged for recheck
Town of Middletown Springs (official website), Board of Listers page: names the three listers: Sally Achey (Chair), Patricia Hemenway, and Randy Kniffin

Town of Middletown Springs (official website), Auditors page: heads its roster 'Auditors as of March 2025' on the town's current page and names Juanita Burch-Clay, Tracy Weatherhogg, and Meredith Morgan; the roster's date is disclosed here. The FY2024 report prints 'Juanita Burch Clay'; the page's hyphenated form governs

Town of Middletown Springs (official website), Public Library Trustees page: states the Public Library Trustees are five, elected to staggered three-year terms, and names Kristal Haynes Hier (Chair, 2027), Glenn Tarbell (2027), Mackenzie Floyd (2028), Bree Gunter (2029), and Linda Hurcomb (2029)

sources.note: Town of Middletown Springs (official website), Trustees of Public Monies page: names Steven Harrington (to 2028) as a Trustee of Public Monies and shows the other two seats (2027 and 2029) VACANT, so only Harrington is minted
17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (elected town moderator, one-year term); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Middletown Springs, FY2024 Town Report: the FY2024 report shows Andrew Hayes held the moderator's office by appointment until Town Meeting 2025; no current holder is published, so no holder is minted
